skeleton_golem.name: Skeleton Golem
skeleton_golem.encounter_default: {mob_name} emerged from the thick darkness; the hall was gripped by cold and the sense of inevitable doom. (Appearance: a giant silhouette of fused bones, glowing runes on its chest, a massive shard of a sword in its hands)
skeleton_golem.encounter_berserk_rage: {mob_name} suddenly let out an unnatural, grinding roar. Its bones flared crimson — necromantic fury has taken hold!
skeleton_golem.encounter_weak_opponent: {mob_name} notices your weakness — the runes on its skull flare bright. It raises a heavy arm, intent on finishing off the wounded.
skeleton_golem.phase_1_text: The runes on {mob_name}'s bones ignite with crimson fire — necromantic RAGE takes hold! It grows stronger!

fatum_tuum.name: Fatum Tuum

promt.general: A titanic figure towers before you — in broken armour, with a disfigured face and an extinguished gaze, wrapped in a flickering collection of faded runes — like a reflection of the hero you could have been.
promt.soul: This is the twisted soul of the hero himself, sealed by the rituals of the Labyrinth. Pain, hostility and fragments of memory of why you are here — all mixed and distorted by someone else's malice. Shadows of the past, the echo of a cursed oath and a foreign will have set you against yourself.
promt.behavior: Fatum Tuum moves with frightening purpose — as if carrying out someone else's will, but sometimes his movements slow, as though he is fighting invisible chains. Sometimes a flash of recognition flickers in the empty sockets — and vanishes at once under a surge of black fury.
promt.communication_style: Speaks harshly, in fragments — scraps of phrases and prayers, familiar but distorted. Sometimes the voice suddenly sounds human — but then turns into a growl or is drowned by an echo: `*hollow echo*: 'Can't... go back... Promised... By faith and...'`

fatum_tuum.encounter_default: {mob_name} materialises out of the swirling gloom, like a waking nightmare. The dead runes beneath his skin flare with a pale light, the chains of the oath tighten, and you suddenly feel that this enemy is a reflection of yourself. (Appearance: broken armour, empty eye sockets, in his hand a shard of a blade covered in old prayers.)
fatum_tuum.encounter_berserk_rage: {mob_name} is seized by a monstrous fury, his voice explodes into the echo of several voices at once, and yours would be among them: "All... for the light! All... is necessary!". His blows become frenzied.
fatum_tuum.encounter_weak_opponent: {mob_name} stops for a moment, as if recognising something familiar in you. Then he slowly raises the blade, and for an instant his voice sounds like your own: "...forgive me..." — and the blow comes down on you.
fatum_tuum.phase_1_text: The runes on {mob_name}'s armour burst one after another — the seal of the Oath cracks, and cold grey light seeps through the rifts.
fatum_tuum.phase_2_text: {mob_name} no longer reflects you — he reaches for you. His borrowed fury and yours become one voice: "We are... one... weapon..."
